review: 702.176a-1: the observation point was 'after the first main phase', which would let the end-step trigger remove a counter, and the expected said the Overlord had no flying although a noncreature permanent keeps its abilities; fixed the observation point to main1 right after the enters trigger and removed the 'no flying' claim.

scenarios.title: A permanent cast for its impending cost enters with time counters and is not a creature
decisions: A casts Overlord of the Floodpits for its impending cost {1}{U}{U}, tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; it resolves and enters. Its enters trigger resolves: A draws two cards and discards a Plains.
A observes the board in the first main phase right after the enters trigger resolves, before any end step.

variants.label: impending
variants.expected: Overlord of the Floodpits enters the battlefield with 4 time counters and is not a creature: it is a noncreature Enchantment with no power or toughness. A's hand holds one Plains and the graveyard holds one Plains.

variants.label: hard_cast
variants.delta: A casts Overlord of the Floodpits for its mana cost {3}{U}{U}, tapping all five Islands, instead of its impending cost.
variants.expected: Overlord of the Floodpits enters with no time counters and is a 5/3 Enchantment Creature with flying. Its enters trigger also resolves as in the base case.

scenarios.title: An impending permanent loses a time counter at the beginning of its controller's end step and becomes a creature when the last is removed

setup.notes: Overlord of the Floodpits was cast for its impending cost. The end step has just begun.

decisions: The game moves to the beginning of A's end step; no one acts. The impending trigger, if it fires, resolves.

variants.label: two_counters
variants.expected: The trigger fires and a time counter is removed: Overlord of the Floodpits has 1 time counter and is still not a creature.

variants.label: last_counter
variants.delta: Overlord of the Floodpits starts with 1 time counter instead of 2.
variants.expected: The trigger fires and removes the last time counter: Overlord of the Floodpits has no time counters and becomes a 5/3 Enchantment Creature with flying.

variants.label: opponents_end_step
variants.delta: It is B's turn (B is the active player) and B's end step instead of A's.
variants.expected: The trigger does not fire. Overlord of the Floodpits keeps 2 time counters and is still not a creature.

scenarios.forge_notes: The start state (cast for impending, 2 counters) needs puzzle-style setup or a prior turn; Forge tracks the impending status on the card.
